title: The Last Name in Hollowmere
text:
An old woman stands where a village used to be. The [fade]Fading[/fade] took Hollowmere at dawn; by dusk she will not remember it was ever there.

She holds out a stitched name-ribbon. "Someone should keep this. I can't anymore."

choices.label: Carry the ribbon
choices.outcome: Forty-one names, stitched in red. Ilse reads each one aloud. The old woman smiles at the ones she still knows.

choices.label: Swear to restore it
choices.outcome: An oath, spoken plainly. She does not believe it. She takes his hand anyway, and the village lives a little longer in him.

choices.label: Let her forget
choices.outcome: Vesper takes the grief and leaves the woman only the morning. She wanders off, humming. The ribbon stays in Vesper's hand, heavier than silk should be.

choices.label: Take it to sell
choices.outcome: Somebody in Lanternrest will pay for real thread. The names inside it don't weigh anything at all.
